bio.text: Nicole "Nikki" Gronli, of Dell Rapids, is the Democratic candidate for South Dakota's at-large U.S. House seat in 2026.
She is a former state director for USDA Rural Development under the Biden administration and a former vice chair of the South Dakota Democratic Party.
Gronli is president of Flatlander Strategies, a marketing company, and announced her candidacy in September 2025.

sources.title: Former USDA appointee announces Democratic bid for Congress in South Dakota
